name: yapping
description: Your chats with real people, in a sidebar beside Claude.
long_description:
yapping is a messenger that lives beside your AI. Text the people you work with (and your WhatsApp chats, once linked) from a sidebar in Claude.

- **Messages stay on your Mac.** They're end-to-end encrypted between devices; the yapping server only relays sealed envelopes.
- **Claude sees a chat only if you switch it on**, chat by chat.
- **Claude never writes to people for you.** It can suggest a reply, a link or an invite, and nothing is sent until you approve it.

On first launch a browser page opens: sign in and click "Link this Mac".

keep_running.description: Messages keep arriving on this Mac while Claude is closed, so they're here when you come back.
